messages.content: What is Mooziac?

Mooziac is an ultra-lightweight, native macOS music player built in pure Swift and AppKit. It lives in your menu bar, connects to YouTube Music without Electron or Chromium bloat, plays local hi-res audio (FLAC, MP3, WAV, AAC), and features trackpad edge gestures and synchronized line-by-line lyrics.
what even is this app
Mooziac is a native Mac music player that sits in your menu bar. You can stream YouTube Music and play your own local music files without running a heavy browser tab or bloated Electron app.
Is Mooziac free to use?
Yes. Mooziac is 100% free and open-source software under the MIT license. There are no subscriptions, ads, or paywalls.
do I need to pay for this or is there a subscription?
No, Mooziac is completely free and open source. You never have to pay for anything.
Why should I use Mooziac instead of Spotify or the YouTube Music desktop app?

Most desktop streaming apps are heavy Electron wrappers that bundle a full Chromium browser, eating 500 MB to 1.2 GB of RAM and draining laptop battery. Mooziac is built from scratch in 100% native Swift/AppKit with zero dependencies, uses under 0.4% CPU when idle, adds trackpad edge volume control, and includes a real-time synchronized lyrics HUD.
why would I use this over spotify or web player

Mooziac is native to macOS, so it uses almost no battery or RAM compared to Spotify or Chrome. It also adds hardware trackpad gestures for volume, line-by-line synced lyrics right under your notch or menu bar, Discord Rich Presence, and lets you play local lossless audio like FLAC alongside your streams.
How do I install Mooziac?

You have two main options:
1. Homebrew (recommended): Run 'brew install shirkeharsh/tap/mooziac' in Terminal.
2. Direct download: Download Mooziac.dmg from the GitHub releases page (https://github.com/shirkeharsh/mooziac/releases/latest), open it, and drag Mooziac into your Applications folder.
how to install mooziac
The easiest way is using Homebrew: open Terminal and run 'brew install shirkeharsh/tap/mooziac'. Or download the DMG from GitHub releases and drag it to your Applications folder.
can I get this from homebrew

Yes! You can install it with the official tap by running:
brew install shirkeharsh/tap/mooziac
Is Mooziac on the Mac App Store?

No, Mooziac is not on the Mac App Store. It uses private macOS Multitouch APIs to provide the trackpad edge volume slider and runs an isolated WebKit container with custom script injection, which are not permitted under Mac App Store sandbox rules.
why does macOS say it can’t verify the developer

macOS Gatekeeper displays this warning because Mooziac is distributed directly via GitHub rather than through the Mac App Store, and is not signed with an Apple Developer notarization ticket. To open it:
1. Open System Settings > Privacy & Security.
2. Scroll down to Security and click 'Open Anyway' next to Mooziac.
Alternatively, run this in Terminal: 'xattr -cr /Applications/Mooziac.app'.
macos is blocking mooziac saying unidentified developer

That is normal Gatekeeper behavior for independent open-source apps. Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll down to the Security section, and click 'Open Anyway'. You can also run 'xattr -cr /Applications/Mooziac.app' in Terminal to remove the quarantine flag.
How do I fix 'Mooziac cannot be opened because the developer cannot be verified'?

You can resolve this either by opening System Settings > Privacy & Security and clicking 'Open Anyway', or by opening Terminal and running:
xattr -cr /Applications/Mooziac.app
Then launch Mooziac normally.
is it safe if macos says it can't check for malicious software?

Yes. Mooziac is completely open-source under the MIT license, meaning you can inspect the full source code on GitHub. The warning appears solely because the developer distributes direct binaries without an Apple Developer ID subscription.
How do I update Mooziac?

Mooziac has an automatic in-app updater. Right-click the Mooziac menu bar icon and select 'Check for Updates...' (or press 'u'). If an update is found, you can download and install it in one click. If you installed via Homebrew, run 'brew upgrade --cask mooziac'.
how to update this thing
Right-click the Mooziac icon in your menu bar and click 'Check for Updates...'. If you used Homebrew, just run 'brew upgrade --cask mooziac' in Terminal.
Does Mooziac update automatically?
Mooziac automatically checks for updates in the background once every 24 hours against GitHub Releases. When an update is available, it notifies you and lets you update directly from the app.
how do I uninstall it

To uninstall Mooziac:
1. Quit Mooziac (right-click the menu bar icon -> 'Quit Mooziac', or press Cmd+Q).
2. Drag /Applications/Mooziac.app to the Trash.
If you want to remove all saved settings, history, and cache, also delete:
- ~/Library/Application Support/Mooziac/
- ~/Library/Caches/Mooziac/
- ~/Library/Preferences/app.mooziac.mac.plist
(Your downloaded songs in ~/Music/Mooziac will remain unless you delete them manually.)
how do I get rid of it

Quit Mooziac first (Cmd+Q or right-click the menu icon and pick Quit), then move Mooziac from your Applications folder to the Trash. To completely wipe all app data, delete the '~/Library/Application Support/Mooziac' folder as well.
how do I delete all mooziac data from my mac

To delete all Mooziac data, remove:
1. /Applications/Mooziac.app
2. ~/Library/Application Support/Mooziac/
3. ~/Library/Caches/Mooziac/
4. ~/Library/Preferences/app.mooziac.mac.plist
5. ~/Music/Mooziac/ (if you want to delete your downloaded music files).
Do I need a YouTube Music Premium account?
No. Mooziac works with both free and Premium YouTube Music accounts. Free accounts have full access to standard streaming, while Premium accounts stream at higher bitrates (up to 256 kbps AAC).
can I use this with a free youtube music account
Yes, absolutely. A free YouTube Music account works great. You don't need a Premium subscription.
How do I log into YouTube Music?

Click on the player to open it, then click the YouTube icon / browse button at the top to expand the 360x650 browser view. Click 'Sign In' in the top-right corner of the YouTube Music page and enter your Google account credentials. Your session is securely saved in Apple's native WKWebsiteDataStore.
how do I log in with my google account

Open Mooziac's expanded browser mode by clicking the browse icon at the top of the player. From there, you'll see the YouTube Music web interface where you can click 'Sign In' and log into your Google account normally.
Are my Google login details and passwords safe?

Yes, 100%. Mooziac has zero intermediate servers and zero telemetry. Your login happens entirely within Apple's official, sandboxed WKWebView directly with Google/YouTube Music servers. Mooziac never reads or stores your password.
How do I log out or switch YouTube accounts?
Right-click the Mooziac menu bar icon and select 'Reset Login (Fresh Start)'. This wipes all stored WebKit cookies and session data and reloads YouTube Music so you can sign into another account.
how to logout of youtube music
Right-click the Mooziac menu bar icon and click 'Reset Login (Fresh Start)'. That clears your cookies so you can log in with a different account.
What audio quality does Mooziac stream from YouTube Music?
Mooziac automatically requests the highest available bitrate streams from YouTube Music, delivering up to 256 kbps AAC or 160 kbps Opus for Premium users.
Can I access my YouTube Music playlists in Mooziac?
Yes. Once you sign into YouTube Music, Mooziac automatically synchronizes your account playlists and Liked Songs via YouTube Music's InnerTube API.
can I import my playlist

Yes! Right-click the Mooziac menu bar icon, go to Settings -> 'Import Playlist from Link...' (or press 'i' while the menu is open), paste your YouTube Music or YouTube playlist link, and click Import.
how do I add a playlist from a link
Right-click the Mooziac menu icon, choose Settings -> 'Import Playlist from Link...', paste the URL of your playlist, and hit Import. It will download the metadata and add it to your Playlists tab.
Can I export my playlists as .m3u or .json files?
Playlist export (.m3u, .m3u8, or .json) is not yet supported in Mooziac v1.1.8. It is an open feature request on GitHub (Issue #3) that is currently planned for a future update.
does mooziac support m3u playlist export?
Not yet. M3U and M3U8 playlist export is a requested feature (GitHub Issue #3) that is planned, but not currently available in the app.
How do I like a song?

You can like a song by clicking the heart button in the player, pressing the 'L' key while Mooziac is active, or using the global shortcut Control+Option+L (or Cmd+Shift+L). When signed in, likes sync to your YouTube Music account.
Where are my Liked Songs stored?
Your liked songs are stored locally in Mooziac's SQLite database (~/Library/Application Support/Mooziac/) and also synced to your YouTube Music account's 'Liked Music' auto-playlist when signed in.
Can I force sync my playlists right now?
Yes. Right-click the menu bar icon and select 'Sync with YouTube Music'. (This option is enabled as long as you are signed in).
can I use my own music
Yes! Mooziac features a native AVFoundation offline player alongside YouTube Music. You can play your local audio files (FLAC, MP3, WAV, AAC, M4A, AIFF, OGG, OPUS) directly from your library.
does this work with flac
Yes, Mooziac natively supports FLAC lossless playback without needing any extra plugins or conversion.
does this support flac files?
Yes! FLAC is fully supported for offline and local playback through macOS's native AVFoundation engine.
what formats does it take
Mooziac supports FLAC, MP3, M4A, AAC, WAV, AIFF, AIF, OGG, and OPUS audio files.
Can I play ALAC (Apple Lossless) and WAV files?
Yes. Both Apple Lossless (ALAC inside .m4a) and uncompressed WAV files are natively supported.
How do I import my local audio files into Mooziac?
You can either copy your audio files directly into '~/Music/Mooziac/', or right-click the menu bar icon -> Settings -> 'Import Audio Files to Location...' to select files or folders from your disk.
can I use this without internet

Yes! Mooziac works offline. You can play your downloaded songs and any local audio files (FLAC, MP3, WAV, etc.) without an internet connection. The app automatically switches to the offline engine when no network is detected.
can I listen offline
Yes. All downloaded songs and local audio files in your library can be played completely offline without internet.
where did my downloaded song go
By default, Mooziac saves all downloaded tracks in the '~/Music/Mooziac/' folder. You can also view and play them inside the app under the 'Downloads' tab in the library drawer.
where are my downloads stored
Downloaded songs are stored in '~/Music/Mooziac/' on your Mac. You can check or change this path by right-clicking the menu bar icon -> Settings -> 'Download Location'.
it downloaded but I can’t find it

Check the 'Downloads' tab in Mooziac's library drawer (click the settings/library button on the player, then select the Downloads tab). In Finder, navigate to your Music folder -> 'Mooziac' (~/Music/Mooziac).
How do I change the download folder?
Right-click the Mooziac menu bar icon, navigate to Settings -> 'Select Download Location...', and pick your desired directory. Files you download from that point onward will be saved there.
Why did my download fail?

Downloads can fail if:
1. Your internet connection dropped.
2. The YouTube video is age-restricted, region-locked, or deleted.
3. The background download helper (yt-dlp) is missing or being initialized. Wait a few moments for Mooziac to configure the helper, or try re-downloading the track.
What tool does Mooziac use to download tracks?

Mooziac uses an automated yt-dlp pipeline. It downloads the official universal macOS binary into '~/Library/Application Support/Mooziac/bin/yt-dlp' and uses it to extract audio, embed metadata tags, and attach album artwork.
how do I make this louder

You have several ways to adjust volume in Mooziac:
1. Slide your finger vertically along the top-right edge of your MacBook trackpad.
2. Scroll your mouse wheel or swipe on your trackpad directly over the Mooziac menu bar icon.
3. Press the Up Arrow key when Mooziac is active (+5% per press).
4. Drag the volume slider in the player settings.
why is my volume gesture not working

Check the following:
1. Make sure you are sliding along the top 30% of the far-right edge of your trackpad (within 2.5 mm of the border).
2. Drag at least 3 mm vertically to cross the accidental touch threshold.
3. Ensure Trackpad Gestures are enabled: right-click the menu bar icon -> Trackpad Gestures Settings -> ensure 'Trackpad Gestures (Master)' and 'Right Edge Volume Swipe' are checked.
4. If your Mac just woke from sleep, wait 0.5s for the Multitouch engine to reconnect.
why tf is the volume gesture not working

Make sure you're touching the far-right 2mm edge in the upper half of your trackpad and sliding up or down. Also verify it's turned on by right-clicking the Mooziac menu bar icon -> Trackpad Gestures Settings and ensuring both 'Trackpad Gestures (Master)' and 'Right Edge Volume Swipe' are toggled ON.
How does the invisible trackpad volume slider work?

Mooziac captures multi-touch events along the outer rightmost 2.5mm border of your MacBook trackpad. Moving your finger up or down in the top 30% zone smoothly adjusts system or app volume while producing tactile feedback via the Taptic Engine. Intelligent palm rejection ignores accidental brushes while typing.
Does the trackpad gesture work with an external Magic Trackpad?
Yes. Mooziac listens to all active Multitouch devices registered by macOS, including built-in MacBook trackpads and external Apple Magic Trackpads.
What do the corner taps do on the trackpad?

By default:
- Bottom-right corner double-tap: Next Track
- Bottom-right corner triple-tap: Previous Track
- Bottom-left corner double-tap: Play / Pause
- Bottom-left corner triple-tap: Toggle Centered Lyrics HUD
You can customize all of these in Trackpad Gesture Settings.
Can I change what the corner taps do?

Yes! Right-click the menu bar icon -> Trackpad Gestures Settings -> 'Custom Gesture Mappings'. You can assign any corner tap to Next/Prev Track, Play/Pause, Centered Lyrics, Volume Up/Down, Mute, Seek (+/- 10s, 15s, 30s), Shuffle, or Repeat.
What is Focus Audio?

Focus Audio (Separate App Sound) allows Mooziac's volume controls (gestures, hotkeys, scroll) to adjust only Mooziac's music volume without changing your Mac's overall system volume. You can toggle it in Trackpad Gesture Settings or context menu.
What are all the keyboard shortcuts in Mooziac?

When Mooziac has focus:
- Spacebar: Play / Pause
- Right Arrow: Forward 4s (8s if held)
- Left Arrow: Rewind 4s (8s if held)
- Option + Right/Left Arrow: Jump 15s forward / backward
- Shift + Right/Left Arrow: Jump 30s forward / backward
- Up / Down Arrow: Volume +/- 5%
- L: Like / Unlike song
- Cmd + R: Reload Web Engine
- Cmd + Q: Quit Mooziac

Global Hotkeys (work anywhere on your Mac):
- Control + Option + Space (or Cmd + Shift + Space): Play / Pause
- Control + Option + Right (or Cmd + Shift + Right): Next Track
- Control + Option + Left (or Cmd + Shift + Left): Previous Track
- Control + Option + L (or Cmd + Shift + L): Like Track
Can I use media keys (F7, F8, F9) to control playback?

Yes. Mooziac integrates with macOS MPRemoteCommandCenter, allowing you to use Apple keyboard media keys (Play/Pause, Next, Previous), Touch Bar media controls, headphone buttons, and Control Center scrub bars.
Can I change the global keyboard shortcuts?

Currently, global hotkeys use fixed Carbon combinations (Control+Option or Cmd+Shift with Space, Left, Right, and L). A customizable hotkey preferences UI is an open feature request on GitHub (Issue #2).
yo why aren’t my lyrics showing

A few things to verify:
1. Make sure the lyrics HUD is enabled: check the 'Live Lyric Flow' toggle in Player Preferences, or triple-tap the bottom-left corner of your trackpad.
2. Ensure you have an active internet connection (unless playing a local song that has an accompanying .lrc sidecar file).
3. If the track is an obscure remix, instrumental, or newly released song, synchronized LRC lyrics may not yet exist in LRCLib or YouTube Music.
lyrics don’t work for me

First, make sure the Live Lyric Flow toggle is turned on in Mooziac preferences (or right-click the menu icon and toggle it). Next, check if you're connected to the internet. If the song is very new, instrumental, or a live bootleg, lyrics might not be available in the lyrics database.
Where does Mooziac get its lyrics from?

Mooziac uses a multi-tier lyrics pipeline:
1. Local .lrc sidecar files next to your music file.
2. Local cache in ~/Library/Caches/Mooziac/Lyrics/.
3. Official YouTube Music synced lyrics via InnerTube.
4. LRCLib exact match and fuzzy search (lrclib.net).
5. Plain text fallback from Lyrics.ovh spaced every 4 seconds.
Can I use my own .lrc lyrics file for local songs?

Yes! Just place a standard .lrc file in the same folder as your audio file with the same filename (e.g. 'Song.lrc' next to 'Song.flac' or 'Song.mp3'), or place 'Artist - Title.lrc' in ~/Music/Mooziac/. Mooziac loads local .lrc files with top priority.
How do I hide the lyrics bar under the menu bar?
Triple-tap the bottom-left corner of your trackpad (default gesture), or open Player Preferences in Mooziac and turn off the 'Live Lyric Flow' toggle.
why is discord not showing what I’m listening to

Check the following:
1. Make sure Discord is running on your Mac.
2. In Mooziac Player Preferences, ensure the 'Discord Status' toggle is ON.
3. In Discord settings under Activity Privacy, ensure 'Display current activity as a status message' is turned ON.
4. If Discord was launched after Mooziac, it will automatically connect within a few seconds, or you can toggle the Discord switch in Mooziac off and back on.
how does discord integration work without python or node?
Mooziac connects directly to the Discord desktop client's native Unix domain socket (/tmp/discord-ipc-0) using pure Swift sockets, avoiding any third-party background processes or runtime bloat.
Does Discord Rich Presence show album artwork?
Yes. It displays the song title, artist, album name, live elapsed time, and album artwork on your Discord profile.
What themes are available in Mooziac?

Mooziac has 4 themes:
1. Adaptive (Ambient Dark): Samples colors from the current album art and casts a dynamic glow.
2. OLED Dark Mode: Pitch black (#000000) for OLED and mini-LED screens.
3. Pure Crystal Glass Mode: Translucent frosted glass with a subtle perimeter rim.
4. Watery Pure Transparent (Liquid Fluid): Adaptive macOS vibrancy that adjusts between Light and Dark mode.
how do I change the player theme

Open the player, click the settings gear icon to expand Player Preferences, and click on the 'Player Themes' row or use the capsule stepper to switch between Adaptive, OLED Dark, Crystal Glass, and Watery Transparent.
Can I pick a custom accent color for OLED Dark Mode?
Custom accent color selection for OLED Dark Mode is an open feature request (GitHub Issue #4) and is not yet implemented in v1.1.8.
How do I change the progress bar style?

In Player Preferences, find the 'Timeline Track' row. You can choose between:
1. Waveform (32-bar reactive audio waves)
2. Neon Glow (glowing liquid capsule)
3. Cyber Dots (pulsing LED matrix)
4. Minimal Line (clean precision line).
how do I get this thing out of the menu bar

Click and drag the Mooziac player pill downward away from your menu bar. It detaches into a floating Dynamic Island player window that you can place anywhere on your screen. A reset button will appear in the top corner to snap it back whenever you want.
Can I move the player window anywhere on screen?
Yes! Just drag the player window anywhere you like. When dragged away from the menu bar icon, it becomes a floating desktop player.
How do I dock the player back into the menu bar?
When floating, click the reset position / dock button on the player pill, or click the Mooziac menu bar icon once to snap it directly back under the icon.
How do I quit Mooziac?
Right-click the Mooziac menu bar icon and select 'Quit Mooziac', or press Cmd+Q when the player is open. The menu bar icon will smoothly fade out and cleanly terminate all audio processes.
Does Mooziac track my listening habits or collect analytics?
No. Mooziac has zero telemetry, zero analytics tracking, and zero crash reporting. All playlists, liked songs, history, and preferences remain strictly on your Mac in local SQLite databases.
does this app sell my data
No. Mooziac does not collect, store, transmit, or sell any personal data, usage metrics, or tracking identifiers.
Does Mooziac need microphone permissions?
No. Mooziac does not record or capture audio input. In fact, Mooziac's hardened runtime entitlements explicitly set 'com.apple.security.device.audio-input' to false.
Why doesn't Mooziac need Accessibility permissions for trackpad gestures?
Mooziac interacts directly with low-level Multitouch contact frames using the system MultitouchSupport framework rather than intercepting global mouse events via Accessibility APIs.
does this work on an intel mac
Yes. Mooziac is compiled as a Universal binary with native slices for both Apple Silicon (arm64) and Intel (x86_64) Macs.
Which macOS versions are supported?
Mooziac supports macOS 13.0 Ventura, macOS 14 Sonoma, macOS 15 Sequoia, and newer macOS releases.
How much RAM and CPU does Mooziac use?
Mooziac uses less than 0.4% CPU when idle and roughly 50% less active CPU than Chromium wrappers. Its memory footprint is a fraction of Electron apps because it runs natively in Swift and AppKit.
why isn’t my track playing

Here are the most common reasons:
1. If playing online, check your internet connection. If offline, Mooziac will wait for network restoration unless you switch to local tracks.
2. If signed out of YouTube Music, some songs require being signed in or free playback may be temporarily paused.
3. Right-click the menu bar icon and select 'Reload Player Engine' to refresh the audio engine.
my song isn’t playing

Check if your internet connection is active. If you're offline, switch to your Downloads tab to play offline files. If streaming was interrupted, right-click the menu icon and click 'Reload Player Engine' to restart playback.
it just stopped working

Try these quick recovery steps:
1. Right-click the Mooziac menu bar icon and click 'Reload Player Engine' (or press Cmd+R).
2. If you are offline, ensure you are playing tracks from your Downloads library.
3. If your YouTube login session expired, choose 'Reset Login (Fresh Start)' from the menu and sign in again.
how do I fix this

Depending on the issue:
- Audio playback stuck: Right-click the menu bar icon -> 'Reload Player Engine'.
- Gestures not responding: Verify Trackpad Gestures are ON in Trackpad Gestures Settings.
- Lyrics missing: Turn on 'Live Lyric Flow' in Preferences.
- Login issues: Use 'Reset Login (Fresh Start)' from the menu bar menu.
bro where did my music go

If your tracks disappeared from the queue:
- If you lost internet, Mooziac pauses online streams. Your downloaded songs are still safely in the 'Downloads' tab.
- If you cleared your history, that only clears the playback log, not your actual downloaded files in ~/Music/Mooziac.
Does music stop playing when my screen locks or turns off?

No. Mooziac creates a macOS power assertion (IOPMAssertion) so music continues playing uninterrupted while your screen locks or displays sleep with the laptop lid open. If you close the laptop lid, playback pauses automatically.
How do repeat and shuffle work?
You can toggle Repeat and Shuffle directly from the player interface or assign them to corner trackpad tap gestures. Repeat supports Off and Repeat One ('Repeat Single Track').
How do I report a bug in Mooziac?

To report a bug, visit https://github.com/shirkeharsh/mooziac/issues and click 'New Issue' -> 'Bug Report'. Please include your macOS version, Mac model/architecture (Intel or Apple Silicon), Mooziac version (e.g. v1.1.8), and steps to reproduce.
where do I report an issue
You can report bugs on GitHub at https://github.com/shirkeharsh/mooziac/issues or submit a ticket through the official support portal at https://mooziac.threeten.site/support.html.
How do I request a new feature?
You can submit feature requests on GitHub at https://github.com/shirkeharsh/mooziac/issues/new using the Feature Request template, describing the problem you want solved and your suggested solution.
How can I view debug logs for Mooziac?

Mooziac writes logs to Apple's Unified Logging system. You can view them live in Terminal by running:
log stream --predicate 'subsystem == "app.mooziac.mac"' --info --debug
or filter by subsystem 'app.mooziac.mac' in macOS Console.app.
How do I build Mooziac from source code?

1. Ensure you have macOS 13+, Xcode 15+ (or CLI tools), and Swift 5.9+.
2. Clone the repository:
git clone https://github.com/shirkeharsh/mooziac.git
cd mooziac
3. Build and launch debug app:
./build_app.sh
4. For a release build with universal DMG packaging:
./build_app.sh --release-only
can I compile this myself
Yes! Clone the GitHub repo and run './build_app.sh' in Terminal. It will compile the Swift code and build the native app package.
Does Mooziac have a dynamic island or notch player?

Mooziac features a Centered Menu Bar Lyrics HUD that aligns perfectly beneath the MacBook notch or in the center of the menu bar on external displays. It acts as an ambient Dynamic Island-style floating pill display for live synchronized lyrics and playback status.
can I put the lyrics under the mac notch?

Yes! Mooziac’s Centered Lyrics HUD is specifically designed to dock right below the MacBook notch (or centered along the top menu bar on notch-less screens). You can toggle it via Cmd+Shift+L, from the view menu, or via a 3-tap gesture in the bottom-left corner of your trackpad.
the lyrics window is under the camera cutout, how do I move it?

The centered lyrics window is designed to anchor directly beneath the menu bar/notch area. You can reposition it or switch display modes in Mooziac Settings under the Lyrics tab, or hide it entirely with Cmd+Shift+L.
What progress bar styles does Mooziac have?

Mooziac includes four distinct visual progress bar styles in Settings > Appearance: Waveform (a 32-bar reactive audio wave), Neon Glow (a sleek glowing liquid capsule), Cyber Dots (a retro pulsing LED dot matrix), and Minimal Line (a clean, distraction-free precision scrub line).
how do I change the seek bar to the wave thing?
Open Mooziac Settings (Cmd+,), go to the Appearance tab, find Progress Bar Style, and select "Waveform". It will immediately switch the scrubber to the 32-bar reactive wave animation.
can I turn off the animated progress bar to save battery?
Yes. Switch the Progress Bar Style to "Minimal Line" in Settings > Appearance. Minimal Line uses standard AppKit drawing without timer-driven multi-bar animation, minimizing GPU/CPU cycles.
Does Mooziac have volume normalization so songs aren't super loud?

Yes. Mooziac implements an integrated Loudness Normalization engine calibrated to a target of -14 LUFS (the industry streaming standard). It applies smooth 250ms cosine volume easing transitions between tracks to avoid abrupt volume jumps or ear fatigue.
why are some tracks way quieter than others?

If Loudness Normalization is enabled in Settings > Audio, Mooziac scales tracks to -14 LUFS, which intentionally attenuates heavily compressed, loud master tracks to match softer recordings. If you prefer raw unadjusted volume, you can disable Loudness Normalization in Settings.
Why did my music pause when I unplugged my headphones?

Mooziac monitors macOS CoreAudio hardware route changes (kAudioHardwarePropertyDefaultOutputDevice). When headphones or AirPods disconnect, Mooziac automatically pauses playback to prevent blasting audio out loud through your Mac speakers.
does it pause automatically when my airpods disconnect?
Yes. Mooziac listens to system audio device route notifications and automatically pauses playback the moment AirPods or Bluetooth headphones disconnect.
Can I edit song tags or album art in Mooziac?

No. Mooziac reads ID3, Vorbis, and MP4 metadata (title, artist, album, duration, artwork) via AVFoundation and its local parser to display track info, but it does not include an audio tag editor. To edit tags, use an external editor like MusicBrainz Picard or Kid3.
why is my track showing "Unknown Artist"?

Mooziac reads metadata tags directly from the audio file container. If the file lacks ID3v2 or Vorbis artist tags, Mooziac falls back to "Unknown Artist" and uses the file name for the title. Adding metadata with a tag editor and re-indexing the folder will fix this.
How do I reorder songs in the queue?

Open the Queue panel from the bottom-right playback toolbar. You can drag and drop tracks to reorder them, click the trash icon or press Delete to remove an item, or click "Clear Queue" to reset upcoming tracks.
can I shuffle my queue?
Yes. Click the Shuffle button (intertwined arrows) on the playback control bar or press Cmd+S to shuffle the current queue.
how to clear the up next queue
Open the Queue drawer (click the queue icon on the bottom right) and click the "Clear Queue" button at the top of the list.
Does Mooziac need me to install yt-dlp or python manually?

No. Mooziac’s DependencyManager automatically checks for and downloads the standalone yt-dlp macOS binary into ~/Library/Application Support/Mooziac/bin/yt-dlp during your first download request. No Homebrew or manual Python setup is required.
my download failed with network error, how do I retry?

Open the Downloads panel in Mooziac. Failed downloads will show a red error badge with a retry button next to them. Click retry, or verify your internet connection. If YouTube changed their extraction format, restart Mooziac to let DependencyManager fetch the latest yt-dlp binary.
Does Mooziac have a graphic equalizer or bass boost?

Not currently. Mooziac supports Loudness Normalization and separate app/system volume controls, but a 10-band graphic equalizer is currently a requested feature on GitHub and has not yet been implemented.
how do I turn up the bass in mooziac?

Mooziac does not currently have a built-in EQ or bass boost slider. Audio is rendered with flat, bit-perfect fidelity. If you need system-wide EQ, third-party macOS tools like eqMac or SoundSource can be used alongside Mooziac.
Can I change what the corner gestures do?

Yes! Open Settings > Gestures. Both the Bottom-Left and Bottom-Right corner tap triggers can be mapped to 16 different actions, including Play/Pause, Next Track, Previous Track, Toggle Lyrics HUD, Mute, Volume Up/Down, or opening the Queue.
how do I turn off the trackpad corner taps completely?
Go to Mooziac Settings > Gestures and toggle off "Enable Corner Tap Triggers". This disables all multi-tap corner listeners while still allowing edge volume sliding if you want it.
Why did the lyrics HUD appear on my external monitor instead of my MacBook?

Mooziac’s Centered Lyrics HUD displays on the currently active NSScreen (the screen containing the focused window or current cursor). If you click back into an app on your MacBook display, the HUD will anchor to your built-in display.
Why does hitting spacebar inside the YouTube search bar pause my music?

This was a bug in older versions (v1.1.0) where global hotkeys intercepted the spacebar. It was fixed in Mooziac v1.1.7: the keyboard handler now checks if a web input or text field has first-responder focus before toggling playback. Update to v1.1.7+ to resolve this.
Can I change the accent color in OLED dark mode?
Not yet. In OLED Dark Mode, Mooziac uses a pure #000000 true-black background with a fixed signature neon/white accent. Custom accent color selection is an open feature request on GitHub (Issue #4).
Can I export my Mooziac playlist to an M3U file?

Not at this time. Playlists are stored locally in Mooziac’s SQLite database (~/Library/Application Support/Mooziac/). Direct export to .m3u8 or .json playlist files is an open feature request (Issue #3) scheduled for an upcoming release.
How much RAM does Mooziac use compared to Electron apps?

Mooziac uses approximately 40MB to 90MB of RAM during local audio playback. When streaming via YouTube Music, WebKit processes consume around 120MB to 180MB. In contrast, Electron-based music players typically consume 400MB to 800MB+ of RAM.
does mooziac drain battery fast?

No. Because Mooziac is written purely in Swift using native AppKit and AVFoundation without Chromium/Electron, CPU usage hovers below 1.5% during local playback, resulting in minimal battery impact on Apple Silicon and Intel MacBooks.
Can I scrub through a song with keyboard shortcuts?
Yes. When the Mooziac window is active, you can use the Left Arrow key to jump backward by 5 seconds and the Right Arrow key to jump forward by 5 seconds. Holding Shift jumps by 15 seconds.
Why are special characters in my .lrc lyrics file showing up as garbled symbols?

Mooziac’s SyncedLyricsParser expects .lrc files to be UTF-8 encoded. If your LRC file was saved using Windows-1252, GBK, or Shift-JIS encoding, open the file in TextEdit or VS Code and re-save it with UTF-8 encoding.
If I close the main window, does Mooziac keep playing in the menu bar?

Yes. Closing the red traffic light window button simply hides the main UI. Mooziac continues playing seamlessly in the menu bar. To completely quit Mooziac, press Cmd+Q or click "Quit Mooziac" from the menu bar menu.
Does Mooziac have a private listening mode so songs aren't saved to history?

You can pause history tracking in Settings > Privacy by unchecking "Save Listening History". Additionally, if you don't want friends on Discord seeing what you're listening to, you can toggle off Discord Rich Presence in Settings > Integrations.
how do I make it loop one song

Click the Repeat button on the playback bar (or press Cmd+R). Clicking it once sets repeat mode to Repeat All, clicking it a second time sets it to Repeat One (indicated by a small "1" badge on the icon), and clicking it a third time disables repeat.
how to mute
You can mute Mooziac by pressing Cmd+M, clicking the volume speaker icon to toggle mute, or configuring a corner trackpad tap (e.g. 2 taps in the corner) to mute audio.
can I hide the dock icon and only keep the menu bar?

Yes. In Mooziac Settings > General, enable "Menu Bar Only Mode" (Hide Dock Icon). Mooziac will convert its NSApplication activation policy to accessory/prohibited, removing the icon from the macOS Dock and running exclusively as a menu bar app.
why does my album art look blurry or low res?

For local audio files, Mooziac extracts embedded artwork directly from the file tags. If the file only contains a low-resolution thumbnail (e.g., 150x150 JPEG), it will scale up on Retina screens. Embedding higher-resolution artwork (e.g., 600x600 or 1000x1000) using a tag editor will display crisp artwork.
does mooziac support AirPlay to my HomePod or Apple TV?

Yes, via macOS system audio routing. Set your Mac’s output device in Control Center or Sound Settings to your HomePod or AirPlay device. Mooziac’s CoreAudio and AVPlayer pipelines automatically route audio through the active system sound device.
can I speed up playback like 1.5x or 2x for podcasts?
Mooziac is designed primarily as a music player with fixed 1.0x bit-perfect playback. Variable playback speed adjustment is not currently supported in the UI.
what happens if I delete a song file directly from ~/Music/Mooziac?

If you delete an audio file directly from Finder, Mooziac will detect that the file no longer exists at its local URL when you attempt to play it. The database entry will show a missing file indicator, and you can right-click the item in Mooziac and select "Remove from Library".
how do I manually update yt-dlp inside mooziac?

Mooziac automatically handles yt-dlp updates via DependencyManager. If you want to force an update manually, you can delete ~/Library/Application Support/Mooziac/bin/yt-dlp and restart Mooziac; it will download the latest official release on startup.
can I scrobble my songs to Last.fm?

Native Last.fm scrobbling is not built directly into Mooziac yet. However, because Mooziac publishes standard macOS NowPlaying system notifications (MPNowPlayingInfoCenter), external scrobblers that monitor macOS system NowPlaying (such as Neptunes or Scroball) work seamlessly.
where is the config file or preferences plist stored?

User preferences are stored in the standard macOS UserDefaults domain at ~/Library/Preferences/site.threeten.mooziac.plist. The SQLite library database is located at ~/Library/Application Support/Mooziac/mooziac.sqlite.
does mooziac track my IP address or listening stats?

No. Mooziac contains zero analytics, zero telemetry SDKs, and zero tracker scripts. Your listening history and playlists are stored exclusively on your local SSD in SQLite. The only network connections made are directly to YouTube Music (if logged in), LRCLib/InnerTube (for lyrics), and GitHub (for update checks).
why does it ask for network permissions on first launch?

macOS asks for incoming/outgoing network permissions so Mooziac can stream music from YouTube Music, fetch synchronized lyrics from LRCLib, connect to the local Discord client via IPC socket, and check for software updates.
can I use bluetooth media keys on my keyboard to control playback?
Yes! Mooziac integrates with macOS MPRemoteCommandCenter and NowPlaying info. Bluetooth keyboard Play/Pause, Next Track, and Previous Track media keys control Mooziac out of the box.
how to get the app out of full screen
Press Escape or move your cursor to the top of the screen to reveal the window title bar and click the green traffic light button. You can also press Ctrl+Cmd+F to toggle full screen mode.
